content.title: Nuggets get tenth consecutive win over Grizzlies | Denver Nuggets
content.text: Nuggets get tenth consecutive win over GrizzliesMatt Brooks●@MattBrooksNBAWriter & Digital Content SpecialistApril 8, 202610:37 PM MDTThe Denver Nuggets got their tenth consecutive win on Wednesday and defeated the Memphis Grizzlies, 136-119. This is the first 10-game winning streak of the Nikola Jokić and Jamal Murray era.Speaking of Jokić, he posted 14 points, 16 rebounds, and 10 assists for his 34th triple-double of the season. This tied his total of 34 triple-doubles from last season despite playing seven fewer games.Murray, meanwhile, dropped 26 points on 8-of-17 shooting and 5-of-10 from distance, 7 rebounds, and 5 assists.Denver got excellent production from its bench, which outscored Memphis' reserves, 58-37. Jonas Valančiūnas led the way with 14 points on a perfect 6-of-6 from the field, plus 4 rebounds and 3 blocks.Another top performer among Denver's backups was Tim Hardaway Jr. The veteran sharpshooter totalled 13 points on 5-of-10 overall shooting and 3-of-8 from distance.
